data.title: Jim Cramer says these 2 cybersecurity stocks can keep climbing as AI threats grow
data.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said investors shouldn’t be scared away by the big rallies in CrowdStrike and Palo Alto, arguing their earnings can justify higher valuations.
